youtube.title: Humpty Dumpty 🥚 Fix It Together! Shapes Sing-Along for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Sing Humpty Dumpty with Robo, and help Humpty get back up! Humpty wobbles on the wall and slides down onto a big soft pile of pillows (boing, he's okay!). Then the friends build him a staircase from four puzzle steps: find which shape fits each hole (rectangle, square, triangle and circle), count the puzzle pieces, count the steps as Humpty climbs back up, and play a point-to-it shape quiz.

What your child learns: the shapes circle, square, triangle and rectangle (and how many sides and corners they have), matching a shape to its hole like a puzzle, counting to four, and cause and effect (soft pillows make a soft landing; steps help you go up).

Sing at home: wobble side to side on "sat on a wall", draw each shape in the air with your finger, and ask "What happens next?" before Humpty slides. The first verse of Humpty Dumpty is a traditional public-domain rhyme (its last line is gently changed so Humpty is never broken); the shape verses, the happy ending and the last chorus are original words written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Uh-oh! Humpty is wobbling! Will he fall?
Whoa, whoa! Hee hee!
Let's sing! Four puzzle pieces will help Humpty!
The last piece is a surprise!
Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall,
Wobble, wobble! What happens next?
Humpty Dumpty had a great fall.
Boing! Hee hee! Soft pillows!
Soft pillows! Humpty is okay!
All the king's horses and all the king's men
Couldn't get Humpty back up there again.
How can Humpty get back up? I know!
We can build steps! Steps go up, up, up!
Count the puzzle pieces with me!
One!
Two!
Three!
Four!
Four pieces! Let's fit them in!
Neigh!
The horse brings a block! A step!
Look, a hole! Which shape fits?
Three... two... one!
The rectangle! Two long sides, two short sides.
Here's a rectangle, long and flat,
Put it down by the wall, like that.
Step by step, we can build it together,
Then Humpty Dumpty can climb up again.
Your turn! Say rectangle!
Rectangle!
Yes! Long and flat!
Hop, hop!
The bunny brings another block!
Look, a hole! Which shape fits?
Three... two... one!
The square! Four sides, all the same.
Here is a square with four straight sides,
Stack it on top, it fits just right.
Step by step, we can build it together,
Then Humpty Dumpty can climb up again.
Count the sides! Hold up your fingers!
One, two, three, four!
Four sides! A square!
Quack!
The duck brings another block!
Look, a hole! Which shape fits?
Three... two... one!
The triangle! Three sides, three corners.
Here's a triangle, one, two, three,
Three pointy corners, can you see?
Step by step, we can build it together,
Then Humpty Dumpty can climb up again.
Make a triangle with your hands!
Three corners! Pointy!
Great triangle!
Hello!
The bear brings the last block!
Look, a hole! Which shape fits?
Three... two... one!
The circle! Round, with no corners.
Here is a circle, round and round,
Click, it fits with a happy sound.
Step by step, we built it together,
Now Humpty Dumpty can climb up again.
Draw a circle in the air! Round and round!
Round and round!
Yes! A circle!
Four steps! What happens next?
Humpty climbs up! Count the steps!
One!
Two!
Three!
Four!
I'm up! Thank you, friends!
Steps help us go up! Hooray!
Now a quick game!
Which one is the triangle? Point to it!
Three... two... one!
Yes! The triangle! Three corners!
Everybody sing!
Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall,
Humpty Dumpty, happy and tall.
All of his friends built the steps together,
Now Humpty Dumpty is back up again.
Bye-bye, Humpty! Bye-bye, friends!
Bye-bye!
Bye-bye!
